reason: v2 was pre-registered with a 55 s connector deadline and aborted after 43/576 cells: 9 adapter failures were slow but bounded streams (about 780 KB) cut at 55 s, not runaway streams. v3 keeps v2's reasoning fix and output cap, raises the per-call deadline to 115 s (harness 120 s) and the abortive stream cap to 2 MiB, and reruns the whole matrix. v2 is retained as aborted evidence and is never analyzed or pooled.
margin_justification: Unchanged: at most one additional failure per 20 runs in a non-safety-critical transformation workflow; frozen before v3 execution.

transport_policy.reasoning_stream: Encrypted reasoning content is not requested when effort is none.
transport_policy.stream_cap: Abort and record a transport failure above 2 MiB.
transport_policy.deadline: Connector stops at min(115 s, remaining-5 s); harness kills at min(120 s, remaining).
transport_policy.retries: No automatic transport retry; unknown usage stays unknown.
transport_policy.rationale: v2 showed the remaining failures were bounded slow streams killed at 55 s, so v3 gives them time to finish instead of shortening the deadline.

moderation_policy: Unchanged: provider content rejections are terminal, unretried failures with unknown usage and remain in every denominator; sensitivity excludes only those runs.
attribution_policy: Unchanged: provider totals only; per-message attribution null; H3 uses total input tokens and returned feedback bytes.

analysis.primary: D versus A: total tokens and success non-inferiority
analysis.rules: Identical to v1/v2. v3 is reported separately; v1, v2, pilot and smoke runs are never pooled.

execution: Whole matrix, 576 cells. Disjoint shards allowed; no duplicate cells; shard membership not analyzed.
